_comment: The known habits (kept under the key patterns). The survey prompt lists them so assistants can match a habit to an id; anything that matches none is kept as unmatched until it is added here.

patterns.title: Paste The Evidence
patterns.summary: Hand over the raw error or log, not your summary of it.
patterns.when: Something failed and there is an error, log or stack trace.
patterns.problem: Fixes aimed at your guess instead of the real failure.

patterns.title: Standing Instructions
patterns.summary: Keep a file of rules and project facts the assistant reads at the start of every session.
patterns.when: The same correction comes up for the third time.
patterns.problem: Explaining the same context again in every session.

patterns.title: Screenshot As Brief
patterns.summary: Paste a screenshot with a one-line correction instead of describing the problem.
patterns.when: The problem is visual: layout, spacing, a wrong state.
patterns.problem: Long descriptions of a screen that still miss the point.

patterns.title: Numbered Punch List
patterns.summary: Batch feedback as 1) 2) 3) so several fixes go into one turn.
patterns.when: After reviewing a screen or a diff and finding several small things.
patterns.problem: One small fix per turn, and losing track of the rest.

patterns.title: Plan Before Code
patterns.summary: Ask for a written plan, edit it, then let the assistant build.
patterns.when: Changes that touch more than a couple of files.
patterns.problem: Large changes built on a wrong assumption.

patterns.title: Clean Slate
patterns.summary: One task per session, then clear the context.
patterns.problem: Old context leaking into the next task.

patterns.title: Options, Then Pick
patterns.summary: Let it lay out options, then answer with a letter.
patterns.when: The goal is clear but the approach is not.
patterns.problem: Committing to the first idea that came up.

patterns.title: Parallel Agents
patterns.summary: Split independent work across several agents and merge the results.
patterns.when: Several independent tasks, or a broad search.
patterns.problem: Waiting on work that could have run at the same time.

patterns.title: Diff Review Gate
patterns.summary: Nothing is kept until a person has read the diff.

patterns.title: Tests As Proof
patterns.summary: Accept “done” only with a passing test run attached.
patterns.when: Logic changes with tests close by.

patterns.title: Second Reviewer
patterns.summary: A separate agent or model reviews the finished change.
patterns.problem: The author marking its own homework.

patterns.title: Blind Accept
patterns.problem: Mistakes nobody saw until they shipped.

patterns.title: Hands On Git
patterns.summary: Let it commit, push and open the pull request.
patterns.when: Routine changes that have already been reviewed.

patterns.title: Saved Prompts
patterns.summary: Turn a prompt typed three times into a named command or skill.
patterns.when: A task that repeats with the same instructions.
patterns.problem: Retyping instructions that drift a little each time.

patterns.title: Tool Bridge
patterns.summary: Let it read trackers, chat and logs directly through connectors.
patterns.when: A task that starts from a ticket or a thread.
patterns.problem: Copying context between apps by hand.

patterns.title: Session Handoff
patterns.summary: End a session with notes the next one picks up.
patterns.when: Long work spread over several days.
